verdict.rationale: monday.com's own claims cover both halves of the story. It says users can automate status updates and reports "on a set schedule", and the developer platform includes cron. It also says workflows can run "the moment data changes" via event listeners and subscriptions. The evidence is short marketing-level snippets with no configuration detail. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how scheduled or recurring workflows are configured and what limits apply, independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled automations work as claimed.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
Key-value storage, a pub/sub queue, cron, logs, and alerts out of the box.
Listen for real-time events and run your workflow the moment data changes.
